description: This file implements API endpoints related to emoji reactions in a sports live-stream platform. It provides routes for listing available emojis, submitting reactions for events, and fetching reaction summaries, utilizing FastAPI's routing system.

methods.name: list_emojis( pageNo: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number"), pageSize: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a paginated list of available emojis for reactions.

methods.name: create_emoji_reaction( reaction_request: EmojiReactionRequest = Body(...), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to submit a new emoji reaction for a specific event.

methods.name: get_event_reactions( event_id: str, request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch the reaction summary for a specific event.
